title: WebArbiter: A Principle-Guided Reasoning Process Reward Model for Web Agents
authors_zh: Yao Zhang、Shijie Tang、Zeyu Li、Zhen Han、Volker Tresp
paper_type_zh: 网页智能体过程奖励模型与偏好数据论文
best_for_zh: 需要用可审计的过程反馈训练或搜索网页智能体的读者。
one_line: WebArbiter turns web-agent state and competing actions into principle-guided process judgements for preference learning and reward-guided search.
WebArbiter 把网页状态与竞争行动转为由原则引导的过程判断，用于偏好学习和奖励引导的搜索。
why: It makes the connection between a data object and a training objective inspectable.
inclusion_reason: The paper changes how a training record, selection signal, reward, or trajectory is consumed by a post-training objective.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Web-agent learning often observes only whether an action eventually succeeds. That signal does not explain whether an agent misunderstood the task, ignored page state, or chose an action that was plausible but incompatible with the goal.

WebArbiter asks how a reward model can judge an intermediate web decision in a way that is useful for training. It treats the decision as a comparison between candidate actions under a task intent and an accessibility-tree state, then makes the reasoning behind the preference explicit.

网页智能体学习通常只观察行动最终是否成功。这种信号无法说明智能体是误解了任务、忽略了页面状态，还是选择了表面合理却与目标不相容的行动。

WebArbiter 追问奖励模型如何以对训练有用的方式判断中间网页决策。它把决策视为任务意图和无障碍树状态下候选行动之间的比较，并明确给出偏好背后的推理。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The training record joins a web task, the current state, interaction history, two candidate thought-action continuations, a structured justification, and a winner. The justification first states reusable principles and then applies them to the particular state.

This representation makes the reward target more than a final preference label. The same record can teach a model to articulate why an action is suitable, score competing trajectories, or supply a search procedure with a preference signal grounded in visible page evidence.

训练记录把网页任务、当前状态、交互历史、两条候选思考—行动续写、结构化理由和获胜者连接起来。理由先陈述可复用原则，再把这些原则应用到特定页面状态。

这种表示使奖励目标不止是最终偏好标签。同一记录可以教模型说明行动为何合适、给竞争轨迹打分，或为搜索过程提供由可见页面证据支撑的偏好信号。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors distil structured justifications from a stronger model, then form pairwise preferences over alternative web-agent continuations. Their process reward model generates a principle, reasoning, and verdict; a second stage uses group-relative policy optimization with a binary verifiable reward.

The official release contains 9,642 distilled justifications for supervised training and 18,921 preference records for reinforcement learning. Each preference record preserves the task context and the compared alternatives, so the reward-model input is inspectable rather than only a scalar logged after an episode.

作者先从更强模型蒸馏结构化理由，再在不同网页智能体续写之间形成成对偏好。过程奖励模型生成原则、推理和结论；第二阶段使用带二元可验证奖励的组相对策略优化。

官方发布包含 9,642 条用于监督训练的蒸馏理由和 18,921 条用于强化学习的偏好记录。每条偏好记录保留任务语境及被比较的备选项，因此奖励模型输入可以检查，而不只是回合后记录的一个标量。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The project reports that its 7B model improves best-of-N action-selection accuracy by 9.1 points over GPT-5 on the reported web-agent benchmark. It also reports gains of up to 6.4 points when the reward model guides trajectory search against the stated comparisons.

Those results support the proposed process record and reward interface under the released benchmark and evaluation protocol. They do not establish that a generated principle remains faithful on unseen websites, altered accessibility trees, or tasks with hidden state not represented in the input.

项目报告，在所述网页智能体基准上，其七十亿参数模型的多候选行动选择准确率比 GPT-5 高 9.1 个点。与文中对照相比，当奖励模型引导轨迹搜索时，最高还提升 6.4 个点。

这些结果支持所发布基准和评测协议下的过程记录与奖励接口。它们并不证明生成的原则在未见网站、变化的无障碍树或输入未表示隐藏状态的任务上仍然忠实。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier web-agent reward designs can label an outcome or directly compare actions without preserving a reusable account of the decision rule. That makes it difficult to inspect whether a preference comes from task intent, page evidence, or superficial action style.

WebArbiter makes the decision principle itself part of the supervised output, and trains the model to connect that principle to a state-specific comparison. The contribution is therefore a process-level preference record and a way to consume it in reward modelling and optimization, rather than a new browser controller alone.

较早的网页智能体奖励设计可以标注结果，或直接比较行动，却不保留可复用的决策规则说明。这使人难以检查偏好究竟来自任务意图、页面证据还是表面的行动风格。

WebArbiter 把决策原则本身纳入监督输出，并训练模型把原则连接到状态特定的比较。因此，贡献在于过程级偏好记录及其被奖励建模和优化消费的方式，而不只是一个新的浏览器控制器。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The structured justifications are generated by models and are conditioned on a textual representation of web state, so they can omit visual cues or encode judge bias. Reuse should test whether verdicts agree with executable success and should keep website, browser, and accessibility-tree versions fixed.
结构化理由由模型生成，并以网页状态的文本表示为条件，因此可能遗漏视觉线索或带入评判偏差。复用时应测试结论是否与可执行成功一致，并固定网站、浏览器和无障碍树版本。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this card when a web-agent project has replayable states and alternative actions but needs a richer learning signal than terminal success. Start by auditing state coverage and preference-label agreement, then compare outcome-only, pairwise-only, and principle-guided reward use under one fixed environment budget.
当网页智能体项目拥有可回放状态和备选行动，却需要比终局成功更丰富的学习信号时，可使用该工作。应先审计状态覆盖和偏好标签一致性，再在固定环境预算下比较只用结果、只用成对偏好和原则引导奖励。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The useful unit is not a generic web demonstration: it is a state-grounded comparison with an explicit reason for preferring one continuation. Before using it for policy optimization, inspect whether the displayed state is sufficient to justify the recorded winner.
有用的单元不是通用网页演示，而是带有明确偏好理由、以状态为基础的比较。在将其用于策略优化前，应检查展示的状态是否足以证明记录的获胜者。
